category_info.light_need: Medium to bright indirect light; avoid prolonged harsh direct sunlight
category_info.humidity: Moderate to high humidity (50-70% preferred); tolerates standard household humidity
category_info.soil_mix: Chunky, well-draining aroid mix with peat or coco coir, perlite, orchid bark and pumice
category_info.fertilizer: Balanced liquid fertilizer at half strength monthly in spring and summer
category_info.repotting: Every 1-2 years in spring when roots become pot-bound
category_info.toxicity_to_pets: Toxic to cats and dogs if ingested (insoluble calcium oxalate crystals)

observations.symptom: Small dry brown tip on one mature leaf
observations.location: Leaf apex of the largest fenestrated leaf
observations.evidence: A 1-2 cm dry brown section at the leaf tip with a thin yellow margin
Multiple healthy leaves with strong fenestration and upright petioles

possible_causes.name: Low humidity or inconsistent watering
possible_causes.reason: Isolated brown leaf tips on an otherwise healthy Monstera usually come from dry air or occasional drying out

possible_causes.name: Minor mineral buildup from tap water
possible_causes.reason: Chloride and fluoride in hard tap water can tip-burn Monstera leaves over time

recommended_actions.action: Water when the top 5 cm of soil dries, then water thoroughly until it drains freely
recommended_actions.reason: Consistent moisture without saturation prevents both tip burn and root rot

recommended_actions.action: Increase humidity with a pebble tray or by grouping plants
recommended_actions.reason: Higher humidity keeps leaf margins and tips intact, especially in heated rooms

recommended_actions.action: Trim only the fully brown tip with clean scissors, leaving the yellow margin
recommended_actions.reason: Cosmetic cleanup without opening fresh wound tissue into living leaf

seasonal_context: In winter, indoor heating dries the air sharply; Monstera growth slows and needs less water but more ambient humidity.
what_to_monitor: Whether new leaves develop without tip damage
Any spreading of brown areas toward the leaf base
limitations: Single-leaf photos cannot reveal soil moisture or root condition
Precise humidity values in the room are unknown
follow_up_questions: How often do you water, and does the pot drain freely?
Is the plant near a radiator or air vent?
